parameters.content:
## Physio Supplies Reorder Agent (DEMO, orders nothing)
Every Friday after the cupboard count: forecast next week's use of each supply item from the **booked appointments** x **usage per treatment** x a **correction learned from the last 8 weeks**, then **order = forecast + safety stock - on the shelf - already in the cart**, rounded up to whole packs.

Writes a **'would order' cart per supplier**, a plain-language **change report** for the practice manager, and **flags for a human** (stock that vanished, near expiry, may run short before the delivery).

**Nothing is ordered** and no supplier is contacted. Practice, suppliers and numbers are made up.

### Guard: never order twice in one week
The order log remembers every cart line per week. Anything already in this week's cart counts as on its way, so a second run adds nothing (or only the difference, if a recount shows more is needed). The review sheet keeps every line the manager already decided; only new lines are added.

### Optional AI step: OFF (not included)
The change report is template text built from the numbers. This is the fallback, and it is what the demo uses. An AI step could go between 'Compare with last order' and 'Write change report' to word the report more naturally; the numbers must still come from the maths. Needs your own API key; not tested here.
## 1. Read the sheets: review sheet, order log, approval log, stock counts, past weeks, next week's bookings, usage rates, suppliers, item list
## 2. For each item: forecast, shelf check, order quantity
